From today, Runna subscription users can access the newly launched "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details as follows.

Runna launches training tool to help runners cope with hot weather

Personal running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at providing comprehensive support to users throughout the entire training cycle—from training in hot weather to post-race recovery, covering every aspect.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature officially launches today, helping users find cooler running windows and suggesting adjusted pace targets based on felt temperature, training duration and specific sessions.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature comes with colour-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to see at a glance and identify the most suitable running times, thereby planning their training accordingly.

Runna shares the following about this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature—whenever a user opens a training plan for a 5K to 50K event, the system will automatically create a recovery plan for them. Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury".

Finally, the platform announced that a brand-new feature, "Upcoming Plans," will launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans and seamlessly transition from one plan to the next upon completion, further simplifying long-term training management.

Runna outlines the advantages of "Upcoming Plans" as follows:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races, transition goals and training blocks to get a clear overview of the entire year at a glance. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—preferred training schedules, predicted finish times and current fitness levels all carry over automatically from the end of one plan to the start of the next. Flexibility on your terms: Every plan can be edited, swapped or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's experienced coaches based on proven training principles, helping runners continuously improve, recover fully and arrive at race day in peak condition.
